blocks.x: Architecture, security posture and audit evidence for Achala Twinverse — digital twin & iot intelligence platform from Achala IT Solutions.

The platform separates three planes. The data plane carries workload (retrofit telemetry with data contracts, physics+data models with validation regime, KubeEdge-class orchestration with OTA); the control plane carries policy and orchestration (RUL models into CMMS scheduling, what-if and capacity simulation); the evidence plane carries audit, replay and conformity documentation — the plane most vendors skip and every regulator asks about.

Twinverse runs IEC 62443-aligned segmentation for industrial estates, hardware roots of trust and signed boot on edge fleets, and privacy governance (face blurring, retention) for camera systems. Telemetry carries contracts — units, timestamps and lineage are trustworthy by construction.

items: platform controls audited; evidence exports mapped to customer audit scopes.
DORA, HIPAA-ready pods, PCI DSS support and GDPR data-residency options where the estate requires them.
NIST AI RMF and ISO/IEC 42001 control mapping; EU AI Act documentation generated for high-risk deployments.

blocks.x: Scaling is horizontal by design — workload planes shard by tenant and region, while the evidence plane compacts to cold storage on schedule, keeping audit queries fast without taxing production throughput.

items: deployed inside your cloud landing zone; customer-managed keys; your SIEM receives telemetry.
operated by our pods under SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 with quarterly evidence exports.
Twinverse and Sentinel patterns extend to plant, store and site estates with signed boot and 62443-aligned segmentation.

blocks.x: OPC UA, MQTT Sparkplug B, LoRaWAN/NB-IoT, KubeEdge/K3s, CMMS/MES adapters. Adapters to core systems (CRM, ERP, core banking, EHR, WMS/MES, SCADA) are versioned contracts — one schema change propagates to every consumer.
